intro: Quiznos is the sub chain that built its name on toasted subs, run through a conveyor oven so the bread is crisp and the cheese melted, with signature subs like the Classic Italian and Mesquite Chicken and its famous dipping sauces. Once a major Subway rival, it is now a smaller chain, but the toasted sub is still the draw. Below is the Quiznos menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Quiznos, signature toasted subs run about $9.35 to $10.80 (Classic Italian $9.35, Mesquite Chicken and Baja Chicken $10.80), salads are $9.99 to $12.99, and a broccoli cheese soup is $5.40. The toasted subs and dipping sauces are the signature. Prices and availability vary by location.
hot_deal: Quiznos value: the smaller sub sizes and the Classic Italian ($9.35) are the cheapest ways in, and the chain has long leaned on coupons and app deals (the old $5 and value-sub promotions). A sub plus a cup of broccoli cheese soup ($5.40) makes a full meal. Prices and availability vary a lot by location.

faqs.q: How much is a sub at Quiznos?
faqs.a: Signature toasted subs run about $9.35 to $10.80 (the Classic Italian is $9.35, Mesquite and Baja Chicken $10.80). Salads are $9.99 to $12.99 and a broccoli cheese soup is $5.40. Prices and the exact menu vary by location, and the chain leans on coupons.

Quiznos is known for its toasted subs, run through a conveyor oven so the bread is crisp and the cheese melted, its signature subs like the Classic Italian and Mesquite Chicken, and its dipping sauces. It was once a major Subway rival.

Yes, but Quiznos is now a much smaller chain than at its peak, with far fewer US locations. Availability varies widely by area, so it is worth checking whether there is a location near you before planning a visit.

Quiznos publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Totals depend on the sub, size, cheese and sauces you choose.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Quiznos?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Classic Italian, the Mesquite Chicken, the Honey Bacon Club, the Baja Chicken, and the broccoli cheese soup.
